name: Cable wrap: other end
description: A plain band that wraps round the cable and says where the OTHER end goes. Type each cable as "GARAGE / LIVING ROOM": you get two bands side by side, LIVING ROOM for the garage end and GARAGE for the living room end. A line without "/" prints one band as typed. The name repeats round the band so it reads from any side; it wraps about 1.5 times so it sticks to itself.

fields.label: Cables, one per line: this end / other end
fields.hint: Each line gives a matching pair of bands

fields.label: Along the cable (mm)
fields.hint: Up to 26 puts a pair side by side
